liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **China Cat Sunflower** (2 reviews): China Cat into Rider is called incredible; the reviewer says to jump straight to it; Full thunder and lightning are audible during China Cat into I Know You Rider [5][9]
- **He's Gone** (2 reviews): He's Gone teases a little Truckin, then The Other One fades to drums and a space before exploding out; He's Gone felt like a tribute to an absent friend, getting deep at the end [5][15]
- **Alabama Getaway** (1 review): Wind can be heard whispering in the microphones during the opening Alabama Getaway [9]
- **Looks Like Rain** (1 review): Looks Like Rain felt fitting as the storm arrived; reviewer wondered why Lazy Lightning was not played [11]
- **Tennessee Jed** (1 review): First-set highlights named are Tennessee Jed, Althea, Minglewood and Deal, plus a wildly energetic first set overall [14]
- **Estimated Prophet** (1 review): Second set is strong before drums, with China>Rider, Estimated Prophet and He's Gone singled out [13]

## Setlist highlights

- **Rhythm Devils**: back after 180 archived shows (857 days); rare: 4 archived performances [17]
- **Iko Iko**: back after 104 archived shows (559 days) [17]

## The recordings

- **gd80-08-16.fob-walker.lemieux.20137.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): audience recording; 24 songs; 171 min; rated 4.6/5 by 5 [1]
- **gd80-08-16.aud.vernon.14044.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 24 songs; 170 min; rated 4/5 by 2 [2]. Said about its sound: First set audio is poor; second set comes from a much better, lower-generation source and is easier to listen to [5]
- **gd1980-08-16.SonyECM250.walker-scotton.miller.88959.sbeok.flac16**: source not stated; 24 songs; 172 min; rated 3.67/5 by 15 [3]. Said about its sound: Reviewer reports great sound quality on this recording; Tape flips occur during He's Gone and Sugar Magnolia; various PA noises throughout the show [3][12]
- **gd1980-08-16.128616.naks.mason.partial.flac16**: source not stated; 14 songs; 89 min; rated 4/5 by 2 [4]

## Around the show

- Reviewer found ticket cost seven dollars and recalls someone dropping a fifty-dollar bill outside the gate [7]
- Weather turned from hot and muggy to wind and rain; crowd roughly 7-8K at the SIU-Edwardsville outdoor amphitheater [9]
- A big Midwest thunderstorm rolled in, band played on, and the hillside became a muddy slide [11]
- Brent plays hard on his modified Fender Rhodes, producing a toy-piano sound [14]
- First show after Keith Godchaux's death; small outdoor shed near the river, perhaps 3,000 people [15]
- Heavy rain fell from He's Gone until Space, soaking everyone beyond the first ten rows or so [15]
- Rain became heavy during Ship of Fools [3]
- Described as quite a show from 1980, a rather uncirculated year [14]
- Reviewer notes Mississippi Half Step was not played despite seeming an obvious choice [16]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd80-08-16.fob-walker.lemieux.20137.sbeok.shnf**: taped by Joani Walker; source: Audience Recording: Sony ECM-250s [1]. Also: Recorded by Joani Walker on FOB MAC with Sony ECM-250s into Sony TC-158, CDR via Paul Scotton; tweaked by Scott Clugston, SHN by Andy Lemieux [1]
- **gd80-08-16.aud.vernon.14044.sbeok.shnf**: source: Audience Recording [2]
- **gd1980-08-16.SonyECM250.walker-scotton.miller.88959.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Joani Walker; transferred by Charlie Miller; source: Sony ECM-250 -> Cassette Master (Sony TC-158/Maxell UDXL-II90) [3]. Also: Tapes came from Joani Walker and Paul Scotton [3]
- **gd1980-08-16.128616.naks.mason.partial.flac16**: taped by Mason B. Taylor; source: Set 1 & Partial Set 2 Recorded By Mason Taylor on a Nakamichi 550 Cassette Deck, on chrome tapes, with Nakamichi microphones; the original version had sector… [4]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Worthpoint: [Original 1980 GRATEFUL DEAD Mississippi River Festival Concert Poster RARE | #1862127320](https://www.worthpoint.com/worthopedia/original-1980-grateful-dead-1862127320) [22]
- Poster by Worthpoint: [Original Grateful Dead Concert Poster for 1980 Mississippi River Festival | #1840122285](https://www.worthpoint.com/worthopedia/original-grateful-dead-concert-poster-1840122285) [23]
